reason: Original shipping XLSX imports failed inside the bundled .NET OPC parser before any cell edits. A minimal read-only reproduction isolated Content_Types namespace serialization; both source files import when only that XML member is reserialized with the default namespace.
scope: Only XLSX source/template imports for the original daily shipping manifest task, including its supplemental model runs.
normalization: Create a private derived import copy. Reserialize only [Content_Types].xml. Verify expanded XML names, attribute values and order, child order and text; verify every other ZIP member remains byte-identical. Record original and derived hashes. Never overwrite the original references.

repair_run.interpretation: Separate post-hoc infrastructure repair cohort; not a replacement primary observation.

extension_policy: All additional models on this task use the same compatibility adapter. The other selected tasks use the unchanged native engine. Require a submitted Sol adapter-repair run before the model extension starts.
error_reporting: Separate wrapper records concise actual exceptions instead of losing the message behind a truncated minified-runtime source line.
budget: Existing amended global ledger and authorized total; no automatic retries and no model calls during offline validation.
